research_question: Among children, what is the effect of a child-feeding intervention, compared with a no-intervention control, on short-term vegetable intake measured less than 12 months after the intervention?
outcome_description: Children's vegetable intake assessed after the intervention and less than 12 months later, using any quantitative measure of amount, frequency, servings, grams, or validated intake score. Follow-up data at 12 months or later will be excluded from this outcome. Where a study reports multiple eligible short-term assessments, use a prespecified single assessment per comparison—prefer the endpoint closest to the end of the intervention; if timing is otherwise equivalent, use the most comprehensive vegetable-intake measure—to avoid double-counting participants.
positive_direction: A positive standardized mean difference means that the child-feeding intervention increased children's vegetable intake relative to no intervention.
search_queries: child feeding intervention vegetable intake trial children
vegetable consumption feeding intervention controlled comparison child
children vegetable intake nutrition intervention quantitative outcome
inclusion_criteria: Original empirical studies involving children and evaluating an intervention broadly intended to influence child feeding, food exposure, dietary behavior, or vegetable consumption.
Studies that include a no-intervention, usual-practice, wait-list, or attention-minimal control condition and assess children's vegetable intake less than 12 months after the intervention.
Studies reporting quantitative vegetable-intake outcomes with sufficient information to calculate or obtain an effect size.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study, including systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, protocols without results, and theoretical papers.
No comparison between a child-feeding intervention and a no-intervention or otherwise eligible control condition.
No quantitative outcome data capable of producing an effect size; eligible information includes means and SDs, t- or F-values, proportions, odds ratios, or equivalent convertible statistics.
Completely unrelated to child-feeding interventions or children's vegetable intake.
Vegetable-intake outcome measured only at 12 months or more after the intervention, with no eligible assessment before 12 months.
moderators_to_extract: Intervention type and core feeding strategy
Timing of vegetable-intake assessment after intervention
effect_size_note: Pool effects as standardized mean differences because studies may use different vegetable-intake measures. Orient all measures so positive values indicate greater vegetable intake with the intervention; compute small-sample-corrected standardized effects where supported by the analysis software. Include only assessments less than 12 months after intervention and do not combine longer-term data with this outcome. Account for clustering in cluster-randomized studies and avoid double-counting shared controls or repeated measurements.
